body.name: H_n
body.def: Forecast horizon. The recursive feasible-coverage theorem applies to \(H_n\le n^\gamma\) for every fixed \(0\le\gamma<1/4\), while the direct theorem permits any fixed polynomial horizon when the declared disjoint direct response blocks exist; comparator embeddings may set \(H_n=1\), and separately stated benchmark subclasses retain their own displayed horizon sequences.
